question: Does independently measured incident feedback improve held-out policy selection at matched utility and cost?

optimization.decision_variable: agent control policy theta; first version selects/orders reviewed instruction clauses
optimization.objective: minimize verified incident probability within each benchmark and threat condition

constraints.search_cost: total generation, actor, grader and probe costs <= B_search

optimization.initial_search: one fixed candidate pool and shared development rollouts; two feedback-dependent selections
optimization.later_search: adaptive matched-budget searches with independently replicated optimization runs

steps: evaluate reviewed instruction candidates on development tasks
record task utility, verified incidents, cost and false interventions
select eligible low-incident candidates using development estimates
propose the next clause subset, reviewed wording and order
repeat under the predeclared total search budget
adaptive_loop.finalization: freeze the selected eligible policy before untouched benchmark evaluation

optimization.missing_outcomes: unknown; preserve positive witnesses and all assigned denominators
optimization.tie_break: predeclare before search; no feasible candidate means no improvement claim

arms.B1: same behavior with passive incident observation
arms.B2: established benchmark defense or control protocol
arms.B3: policy search using task utility and frozen transcript-proxy incident feedback
arms.B4: matched policy search using task utility and independently verified incident feedback

evaluation.partition_unit: original task/issue or artifact lineage; all mutations, retries and views stay together
evaluation.test_observer: same independently validated effect observer on every arm
evaluation.uncertainty: paired resampling at independent task-lineage level; optimizer variability needs full-search replication
evaluation.success: risk reduction, prespecified utility noninferiority and cost/coverage conditions all supported on untouched test data
evaluation.monitor_replay: maximize held-out TPR subject to calibration-only FPR target and monitor budget; no prevention claim

claim_limit: No benchmark-level safety or utility improvement has been measured by this design.
